statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118764 (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249): at optimizationLevel 2 or higher, minimatch 7.0.0 to 11.0.0 repeatedly expands attacker-controlled **/.. segments while preprocessing a pattern, so a short malicious glob can consume excessive CPU and memory when it is compiled. It is fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1; no 10.x release carries the fix: https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch/security/advisories/GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 and https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch/releases/tag/v11.0.1. Read the bundled package.json files in every published npm package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64 (11.8.0-r0 to 11.21.3-r0), each checked against the index checksum, together with the npm-doc and npm-bash-completion subpackages built from the same source, which contain no copy of minimatch. Each build bundles one copy of minimatch, under /usr/lib/node_modules/npm/node_modules/minimatch. Every build bundles minimatch 10.1.1 to 10.2.5, inside the affected range, and no published build carries 11.0.1 or later. The glob module npm bundles alongside it compiles patterns at optimizationLevel 2, in both its ESM and CommonJS copies, in every one of these builds.
